While the result is not ideal, manager Unai Emery will likely use this experience to fine-tune his squad ahead of the season's commencement. Supporters will be looking for improved defensive solidity and more attacking impetus in the remaining warm-up matches.

articles.headline: Veteran Tadić Joins NEC Nijmegen for Champions League Qualifying Push
articles.summary: Experienced Serbian international Dusan Tadić has officially signed with Dutch club NEC Nijmegen, bringing his Champions League pedigree to their upcoming qualifying campaign. The move marks a significant boost for NEC as they prepare for their first European competition in over a decade.
articles.body:
Former Ajax playmaker Dusan Tadić has completed a return to the Netherlands, joining NEC Nijmegen on a two-year contract today. The 37-year-old midfielder arrives at a crucial time for NEC, who are set to embark on their UEFA Champions League journey in the third qualifying round next week.

NEC Nijmegen secured a surprise third-place finish in the Dutch league last season, earning them a coveted spot in European competition for the first time since 2009. Tadić, known for captaining Serbia at the 2022 World Cup and his instrumental role in Ajax's 2019 Champions League semi-final run, will be a key figure as they face Greek side Olympiakos in their initial challenge.

His arrival is expected to provide invaluable experience and leadership to the squad as they navigate the rigorous qualifying stages. Tadić was a free agent after a season with Al Wahda in Abu Dhabi, and his decision to join NEC underscores the club's ambition to make a significant impact on the continental stage.

articles.headline: Bromley Stuns Crystal Palace with Dominant Pre-Season Victory
articles.summary: Crystal Palace suffered a surprising 3-0 defeat to non-league side Bromley in a pre-season friendly on Saturday, raising questions for the Eagles' preparations. The result at Hayes Lane saw the lower-division team control the match and secure a memorable win over their Premier League opponents.
articles.body:
Crystal Palace endured a challenging outing in their pre-season schedule, falling to a comprehensive 3-0 loss against National League outfit Bromley on Saturday. The Eagles, a Premier League side, struggled to assert their dominance against a determined Bromley team playing on their home turf at Hayes Lane. This unexpected result marks a significant moment in Palace's pre-season, as they continue to fine-tune their squad ahead of the upcoming Premier League campaign. 

The performance will undoubtedly prompt reflection within the Crystal Palace camp, with manager and coaching staff assessing the factors behind the surprising scoreline. While pre-season friendlies are primarily about building fitness and integrating new tactics, a defeat of this nature to a non-league opponent will certainly spark discussions among fans and pundits alike regarding the team's readiness. 

Bromley, conversely, will be celebrating a fantastic victory that showcases their potential and provides a massive boost as they prepare for their own league season. The decisive 3-0 scoreline against a top-flight club highlights a strong collective effort and execution from the Ravens, giving them bragging rights and momentum moving forward.

articles.headline: AC Milan Shatters Transfer Record for PSG Striker Gonçalo Ramos
articles.summary: AC Milan has completed a massive club-record signing, securing Portuguese forward Gonçalo Ramos from Paris Saint-Germain for a staggering €74 million. This significant investment signals the Rossoneri's strong backing for new manager Ruben Amorim as they build for the upcoming season.
articles.body:
AC Milan has made a definitive statement in the summer transfer window, officially announcing the acquisition of striker Gonçalo Ramos from French champions Paris Saint-Germain. The deal, valued at an impressive €74 million, represents a new club record for the Rossoneri, highlighting their ambition to compete at the highest level.

The Portuguese international's arrival is seen as a crucial move to bolster Milan's attacking prowess under the guidance of newly appointed manager Ruben Amorim. Ramos, known for his clinical finishing and powerful presence, is expected to lead the line and provide a significant goal threat for the Serie A giants in the 2026-27 campaign.

This blockbuster transfer underscores Milan's commitment to supporting their new coach and revitalizing their squad. Fans are eagerly anticipating Ramos's debut, hoping his record-breaking move will translate into immediate success on the pitch and help the club challenge for major honors.

articles.headline: Real Madrid Officially Registers Cucurella and Konate for La Liga Season
articles.summary: Real Madrid has successfully registered new signings Marc Cucurella and Ibrahima Konate with La Liga, bolstering their squad ahead of the 2026-27 campaign. These crucial registrations allow both defenders to participate as the club prepares for the upcoming season.
articles.body:
Real Madrid has taken significant steps in finalizing their squad for the impending La Liga season by officially registering Marc Cucurella and Ibrahima Konate. Cucurella, the talented left-back, joined Los Blancos from Chelsea in a deal valued at €55 million, with potential add-ons. Konate, a robust defender, arrived at the Spanish capital on a free transfer after concluding his tenure with Liverpool.

These latest registrations follow the earlier addition of Denzel Dumfries to the official squad list. As of now, Real Madrid and Espanyol are reportedly the only clubs in Spain's top flight to have begun the formal process of registering players for the new season, with five players across both teams officially confirmed.

While the club has moved swiftly to secure these key defensive additions, Portuguese midfielder Bernardo Silva is still awaiting his official registration. The new additions are expected to play a vital role as Real Madrid aims for a strong start to the 2026-27 La Liga campaign.

articles.headline: Egyptian Giants Zamalek and Pyramids Secure CAF Champions League Berths
articles.summary: The Egyptian Football Federation has officially confirmed the nation's representatives for the upcoming 2026-27 CAF continental club competitions. Pyramids FC and Zamalek are set to compete in the prestigious Champions League, while record holders Al Ahly will participate in the Confederation Cup.
articles.body:
The Egyptian Football Federation recently announced its selections for the 2026-27 CAF Champions League, with Pyramids FC and Zamalek earning spots in Africa's premier club competition. This decision follows a comprehensive review of club performances and adherence to qualification criteria, ensuring Egypt sends its strongest contenders to the continental stage.

Notably, the reigning CAF Champions League record holders, Al Ahly, will instead feature in the CAF Confederation Cup for the upcoming season. They will be joined by ZED FC in the secondary continental tournament, marking a significant shift in Al Ahly's continental aspirations for this campaign.

This allocation sets the stage for an intriguing season in African club football, with both the Champions League and Confederation Cup promising intense competition. Egyptian clubs will be eager to make their mark and bring continental glory back to the North African nation.

articles.headline: European Hopefuls Dominate First Legs in Champions League Qualifiers
articles.summary: Several clubs asserted their authority in the initial matches of the Champions League second qualifying round this past week, securing commanding victories and setting themselves up strongly for advancement. Teams like Crvena Zvezda, Sturm Graz, and Lech Poznań delivered impressive performances to take significant leads into their upcoming return fixtures.
articles.body:
The UEFA Champions League second qualifying round's first legs delivered a flurry of decisive results, as a number of teams established dominant positions. Serbian powerhouse Crvena Zvezda showcased their intent with a resounding 4-0 away triumph over Northern Ireland's Larne, signaling a strong start to their European campaign.

Austrian side Sturm Graz also made a powerful statement, dispatching Scottish club Hearts with a convincing 4-0 victory on home soil. Meanwhile, Polish outfit Lech Poznań put in a stellar performance on the road, defeating Danish club Aarhus 4-1 to gain a significant advantage before the second leg. Other notable results included Slovan Bratislava's comfortable 2-0 away win against Georgian side Iberia 1999, while Dinamo Zagreb secured a 1-1 draw against Thun.

These strong first-leg showings have provided a clear indication of which teams are poised to progress in the competition. With the return matches scheduled for later this week, the spotlight now turns to whether the leading clubs can consolidate their advantages and secure their berths in the next stage of the Champions League qualifiers.

articles.headline: Deportivo Debutant Aubameyang Draws Blank in Goalless Oviedo Friendly
articles.summary: Newly promoted La Liga side Deportivo La Coruña played out a scoreless draw against Real Oviedo in a pre-season friendly, with star summer signing Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang making his debut. The match was unfortunately marred by injuries to two Deportivo players, raising early concerns for the club.
articles.body:
Deportivo La Coruña, making their return to La Liga this season, kicked off their pre-season preparations with a goalless draw against Real Oviedo on Saturday at the Estadio Carlos Tartiere. All eyes were on new recruit Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang, who featured for the Galician club for the first time since his transfer. The former Arsenal and Marseille striker had an opportunity to open his scoring account, but his effort was well saved.

The friendly encounter, however, was overshadowed by injury concerns for the newly promoted side. Deportivo saw both Ilyas Chaira and Adrià Altimira forced off the pitch due to knocks. Altimira was substituted before the half-hour mark after a collision, while Chaira followed ten minutes later, signaling discomfort in his right arm. These early setbacks will undoubtedly be a worry for the Deportivo coaching staff as they build towards the demanding La Liga season.

Despite the injuries and the lack of goals, the match provided a valuable opportunity for both managers to assess their squads and build fitness. Deportivo, who secured their promotion to Spain's top flight for the first time since 2018, will be keen to integrate their new signings and ensure their squad is robust ahead of a challenging campaign.
